features.feature: The Vocabulary panel opens from the book beside Calls, ⌘K or `#settings/vocabulary`
"Every call" terms are added (≤ 50 chars) and removed (×) and saved
"Learned from calls" lists each term with its meetings, people and calls; Always moves it to every call, Remove forgets it; a filter shows past 6 terms
Transcription hints a call with the always terms, its threads' glossaries and the learned terms of its meeting or people only
